<translate>
The '''Namekian Ruins''' are a Namekian settlement razed by Frieza's army on [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]]. A Frieza soldier stands in the scorched plaza; killing it starts the [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion|Frieza's Invasion]] raid.
</translate>

<translate>
== Starting the raid ==
</translate>
{{Main|Frieza's Invasion}}
<translate>
* When you come within 80 blocks of the ruins, you get a chat warning.
* Each site has one scout, the Frieza soldier in the plaza, shown with a supervillain aura. Killing it starts [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion|Frieza's Invasion]].
* A site is spent once its scout dies or disappears.
</translate>

<translate>
See [[Special:MyLanguage/Raids|Raids]] for how a raid plays out.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding one ==
</translate>
<translate>
Namekian Ruins generate spread out across Namek, away from the Ajissa villages. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate namek_ruins}} on Namek to find the nearest one.
</translate>
